Checked stable View sorting is accepted on finite native Linux x86_64 CPU output from the GPU compiler: eight registered library tests (seven native plus one capability group/four marked rejections), all 123 migrated sort_rows cases and standalone build/examples. There is no raw byte copying, recursion, nested Clone/Destroy, adaptive-input promise or comparator-trap rollback guarantee.
